subject: Harden long note cluster ingest daemon startup wait
description: Fix the long-note cluster ingest test flake without changing product behavior. The test sometimes fails at 'sandboxed daemon came up' because the sandboxed daemon can exceed the 10s ping window, especially while spawning embedding sidecar/model setup, and stdio is ignored so failures are hard to diagnose. Scope should stay in test/long-note-cluster-ingest.test.js unless a shared test helper already exists. Increase the bounded startup wait/backoff enough for loaded local runs, capture daemon stdout/stderr to a buffer, detect early daemon exit if practical, and include useful diagnostics only when startup fails. Verify by running node test/long-note-cluster-ingest.test.js at least twice and git diff --check.

summary: Hardened the long-note cluster regression daemon startup wait: the test now waits up to 30s with bounded backoff, captures daemon stdout/stderr in capped buffers, detects early daemon exit, and prints startup diagnostics only on failure.
